titleText: Malta ranks last in EU for share of tertiary students pursuing STEM subjects
mainText: From Times of Malta: Malta ranks last in EU for share of tertiary students pursuing STEM subjects. Proportion is less than half the EU average following the sharpest decline among member states

titleText: Man denied bail over alleged knife attack at Qormi snack bar
mainText: From Times of Malta: Man denied bail over alleged knife attack at Qormi snack bar. Accused pleads not guilty to slightly injuring another man during an argument

titleText: Robert Abela calls for fair EU budget deal, with adequate funding for Cohesion Policy
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Robert Abela calls for fair EU budget deal, with adequate funding for Cohesion Policy. Prime Minister Robert Abela has called for a fair agreement on the European Union's 2028-2034 budget, stressing the need to maintain adequate funding for Cohesion Policy while taking into account the different circumstances of member states.

titleText: Massive 122-unit block in Nigret approved by Planning Authority
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Massive 122-unit block in Nigret approved by Planning Authority. A large-scale 122-unit residential project in the Nigret area of Żurrieq has been given the green light by the Planning Authority (PA). The permit was passed with near-total consensus, with environmental NGO representative Romano Cassar casting the sole dissenting vote.

titleText: Contractor delays held up Triq tal-Qares repaving after works, Enemalta says
mainText: From MaltaToday: Contractor delays held up Triq tal-Qares repaving after works, Enemalta says. Reinstatement works on a section of Triq tal-Qares in Mosta are expected to begin in the coming days, Enemalta has said, following delays by the private contractor engaged to carry them out.
